counterfactual.change: Changed only initial.x from 0.4367 to 0.0; same dt, steps, plant, gains and zero pushes/noise. Removes initial position bias so monotonic drift no longer reaches the wall within 261 steps, proving the violation is due to unchecked cart-position drift under pole-prioritizing control, not pushes or noise.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes or sensor noise; initial cart offset x=0.44 m and velocity v=0.31 m/s with pole upright. The state-feedback controller prioritizes pole regulation (theta ~0.08 rad, margin 0.71 rad) over cart position, applying a small persistent positive force (~0.8-0.87 N) in the drift direction to keep the pole balanced rather than braking the cart. Cart velocity grows monotonically from 0.30 to 1.37 m/s over 261 steps, position drifts from 0.43 m to 2.40 m, exceeding the 2.4 m track at step 261. Reducing only initial x from 0.436 to 0.0 removes the position bias and the scenario runs clean, confirming the drift/bias cause.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: Frames 258-261 show the blue cart with the pole still near-upright positioned at the far right of the track and edging further right. By step 261 the cart is highlighted as the violating body at the right boundary, exceeding the 2.4 m track limit while the pole remains balanced.
